responsibility: Defines the backend interface for post-IR writing and optimization stages, including module linking, fat and thin LTO workflows, optimization/codegen passes, serialization of modules and thin-link data, and the buffer abstractions used to carry compiled or serialized module contents.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `back/write.rs`, which implements the shared scheduling and artifact pipeline, this file only defines the backend-facing traits and buffer abstractions that a backend must implement for linking, optimization, LTO, serialization, and final code emission.
